mods.name: RetroDragon
mods.description: Rebuilds Minecraft Beta 1.7.3's client stack: SDL3 windowing, input and context in place of LWJGL 2, a faster rendering backend with a choice of WebGPU (Dawn) path or OGL 4.6 to 2.1 depending on compatability, and native window/titlebar theming.
